title: The Lord's Servant and the New Covenant
description: God presents his chosen servant, upon whom he has placed his Spirit. The servant will bring justice to the nations without shouting or breaking a bruised reed. The Lord calls him in righteousness and gives him as a covenant for the people and a light for the nations, to open blind eyes and lead prisoners out of darkness. The Lord declares that he will not give his glory to another and proclaims new things before they spring forth [ref:Jes 42:1-9|Isaiah 42:1-9].
